config.modulation.title: Modulation Config
config.modulation.unavailable: Unavailable: %s is installed and already provides this fix.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_bugfixes: Fix GUI Focus Bug (MC-259387)
Fixes a vanilla bug where buttons/sliders retain keyboard focus after being clicked.
Attack Sleeping Villagers (MC-148559)
Allows you to directly attack villagers while they are sleeping.
Fix Dimension Experience Loss (MC-124177)
Fixes a vanilla bug where experience levels disappear when changing dimensions without portals.
Fix Resource Filter Leak (MC-271761)
Properly couples namespace and path checks for resource filters to prevent them from leaking into other namespaces.
Fix Horizon Line
Removes the twilight ring drawn over the sky at sunrise and sunset, which renders in front of distance fog and leaves a hard line along the horizon.
Fix Cave Sky Rendering
Stops the sky and clouds from rendering behind culled chunks when the camera is deep underground, such as in ancient cities and large open caverns.
Better Pause Freezing
Freezes animated textures (like water, fire, lava, and portals) when the game is paused in singleplayer.
Colored Crack Particles
Makes item crack/breaking particles honor item coloration, such as dyed leather armor.
Ghast Charging Animation
Brings back the classic ghast charging/swelling animation when preparing to shoot a fireball.
Allow Mobs to Cross Rails (MC-33359)
Fixes an issue where mobs refuse to pathfind across minecart rails by treating them as unpassable.
Fix Unsaved Chunks (MC-224729)

Saves partially generated and never-loaded chunks that vanilla silently discards, preventing world corruption and regenerated terrain. Automatically disabled when Chunk Saving Fix or Moonrise is installed.
Fix Spectator Firework Boost (MC-119754)
Stops a firework rocket from continuing to boost you along after you switch into spectator mode mid-flight.
Fix Item Frame Load Sound (MC-123450)
Stops item frames from playing their add-item sound every time they are read back from disk, which causes a burst of clicks whenever a chunk loads.
Fix Spectator Item Use (MC-129909)
Releases the item you are using when you switch into spectator mode, so food and drinks no longer finish being consumed afterwards.
Fix Spectator Freezing (MC-215530)
Clears the powder snow freezing effect immediately when you switch into spectator mode instead of leaving the icy overlay on screen.
Fix Mirrored Double Chests (MC-134110)

Flips the left/right half of double chests when a structure is placed mirrored, so mirrored builds no longer split their double chests into two single ones. NeoForge already includes this fix, so this only applies on Fabric.
Fix Dying Pufferfish Sting (MC-155509)
Stops a pufferfish that is already dead from still stinging and poisoning players it touches.
Fix Lightning Item Drops (MC-206922)
Gives items dropped by a mob killed by lightning a moment of immunity so they are not instantly destroyed by the same lightning bolt.
Fix Experience Orbs in Lava (MC-226961)
Makes experience orbs float on flowing lava based on their eye level instead of treating any lava block as a full block.
Fix Enderman Teleport Spam (MC-227008)
Stops endermen riding a boat or minecart from constantly trying to teleport away in daylight.
Fix Zombie Door Particles (MC-263999)
Restores the block breaking particles when a zombie breaks down a door, which vanilla misses because the door is removed before its block state is read.
Fix Creeper Igniter Durability (MC-264285)
Stops unbreakable flint and steel from being consumed entirely when used to ignite a creeper.
Fix Wild Wolf Breeding (MC-93018)
Stops untamed wolves from showing breeding hearts when fed, since they cannot actually breed until they are tamed.
Fix Piston Reload Updates (MC-89146)
Keeps chunk block entities in insertion order so pistons do not lose a pending update when their chunk is reloaded.
Fix Fishing Rod Kill Credit (MC-100991)
Credits the player with the kill when an entity is killed by being reeled in with a fishing rod.
Fix Strafing Mob Aim (MC-121706)
Makes skeletons and illusioners keep looking up and down at their target while strafing, instead of only tracking them horizontally.
Fix Command Minecart Cooldown (MC-121903)
Saves the execution cooldown of command block minecarts to NBT so they do not fire again immediately after a reload.
Fix Empty Command Minecart Message (MC-131562)
Stops an empty "Command set: " message being sent when you press Done in a command block minecart with no command, matching normal command blocks.
Fix Armor Stand Break Particles (MC-132878)
Spawns breaking particles when an armor stand is destroyed by an explosion, lava or fire, not just when it is punched.
Fix Death Screen Item Use (MC-133218)
Stops the item you were using from continuing to be used on the death screen when the keepInventory gamerule is on.
Fix Riptide and Depth Strider (MC-136249)
Stops Depth Strider boots from weakening a Riptide trident launch.
Fix Fishing Bobber Sound (MC-139041)
Moves fishing bobber cast and retrieve sounds onto the Players sound slider instead of Friendly Creatures.
Fix Witch Hut Cats (MC-147659)

Positions the cat before its variant is chosen so witch huts spawn black cats instead of a variant picked from the world origin's biome. NeoForge already includes this fix, so this only applies on Fabric.
Fix Fox Loot Gamerule (MC-153010)
Makes the doMobLoot gamerule apply to the item a fox is carrying, which vanilla drops regardless.
Fix Expired Ban Login (MC-158900)
Clears expired temporary bans before the login check, avoiding a "bad packet id 26" disconnect on the first login after a ban runs out.
Fix End Island Rings (MC-159283)
Fixes an integer overflow that makes End terrain repeat in rings around the world center instead of thinning out. Only affects generation extremely far from spawn.
Fix Piston Moved Cactus (MC-160095)
Checks the block a piston is actually moving rather than the moving-piston block itself, so partial blocks no longer break cacti when pushed past them.
Fix Bad Omen Tooltip (MC-170462)
Shows Bad Omen as a harmful effect in potion tooltips instead of a neutral one.
Fix Glowing Tooltip (MC-84661)
Shows Glowing as a harmful effect in potion tooltips instead of a neutral one.
Fix Respawn Anchor Stat (MC-176806)
Increments the glowstone "used" statistic and scoreboard criterion when charging a respawn anchor.
Fix Locate Distance (MC-177381)
Stops /locate reporting a nonsense distance when the structure is more than 46,340 blocks away, which overflows vanilla's distance math.
Fix Creeper Defusing (MC-179072)
Makes a creeper stop swelling when its target switches to Creative or Spectator mode, instead of continuing to prime.
Fix Group AI on Target Death (MC-183990)
Clears a mob's target once that target dies, so pack AI for wolves, piglins and similar mobs does not get stuck.
Fix Crystals Healing Dying Dragon (MC-187100)
Stops end crystals beaming health into the ender dragon while it is playing its death animation.
Fix Cured Villager Jockey (MC-200418)
Dismounts a cured baby zombie villager from its chicken, instead of leaving a baby villager riding it forever.
Fix Campfire Smoke Position (MC-201374)

Passes the correct position when checking whether a block blocks campfire smoke, so hay bales and similar blocks are detected properly. NeoForge already includes this fix, so this only applies on Fabric.
Fix Shulker Bullet Bubbles (MC-221257)
Makes shulker bullets leave bubble particles when travelling through water, like other projectiles.
Fix Shulker Bullet Impact (MC-227337)
Plays the hit sound and spawns explosion particles when a shulker bullet strikes an entity, not only when it hits a block.
Fix Flower Pot Stat (MC-231743)
Increments the "used" statistic for the plant when you put it into a flower pot.
Fix Peaceful Strider Saddles (MC-232869)
Stops adult striders spawning already saddled on Peaceful, where the zombified piglin rider is never created.
Fix Raid Horn Sound (MC-245394)
Moves the raid horn onto the Hostile Creatures sound slider instead of Friendly Creatures.
Fix Missing server.properties Warning (MC-264979)
Stops a NoSuchFileException being logged on a fresh server installation that has no server.properties yet.
Fix Reload Command Suggestions (MC-267125)
Resends the command tree after /reload so suggestions for datapack-driven content update without rejoining.
Fix Structure Save Path (MC-268617)

Widens the reserved Windows filename check so structure blocks can save in game directories with names like "com.example", which affects some Flatpak and launcher setups. NeoForge already includes this fix, so this only applies on Fabric.
Fix Structure Palette Threading (MC-271899)

Makes the structure template block cache thread safe, avoiding rare corruption and crashes when structures generate on several threads at once. NeoForge already includes this fix, so this only applies on Fabric.
Fix Slow Falling Particles (MC-30391)
Stops chickens, blazes and the wither kicking up landing particles, since they fall too slowly to take fall damage.
Fix RCON Newlines (MC-7569)
Keeps line breaks in RCON command output instead of collapsing every response onto a single line. NeoForge already includes this fix, so this only applies on Fabric.
Fix Dragon Landing in Void (MC-88371)
Stops the ender dragon flying down into the void when the exit portal has been destroyed.
Fix Cave Spider Spinning (MC-94054)
Stops cave spiders spinning in place while walking, caused by their small hitbox overshooting path nodes. NeoForge already includes this fix, so this only applies on Fabric.
Fix 2x2 Sapling Growth (MC-8187)
Lets 2x2 jungle and spruce saplings grow when there is a block directly north or west of the formation, which vanilla wrongly treats as blocking.
Fix Raw Copper Block Sounds (MC-223153)
Gives the Block of Raw Copper copper sounds instead of stone sounds. Takes effect after a restart.
Fix Final Eating Sound (MC-202637)
Moves the last clip of the eating sound onto the Players sound slider, so it stops playing when that slider is at zero.
Fix Shield Sounds (MC-255756)
Plays the shield block and shield break sounds for everyone nearby, not just the player holding the shield.
Dirt Paths Under Blocks (MC-84731)

Lets dirt paths survive and be made under blocks that do not have a full bottom face, such as fence gates, trapdoors, top slabs, glass panes, wall signs and bells, and lets wall torches attach to dirt path blocks.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_visual.n: Replaces standard map colors with softer, more aesthetically pleasing palettes.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_visual.w: Displays a honeycomb icon on waxed items.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_visual.e: Displays redstone/silverfish icons on trapped chests and infested blocks.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_visual.b: Improves formatting and consistency of copper tooltips.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_visual.l: Adjusts non-glowing sign text colors to improve legibility and contrast against wood.
Lowers the on-fire screen overlay and hides it entirely when you have Fire Resistance or are immune to fire.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_visual.p: Draws 3D dropped block items with consistent pixel scale (sampling an 8x8 portion of the texture), emulating Survival Test block drop rendering.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_gameplay: Flammable Cobwebs
Allows cobwebs to catch fire and burn.
Campfires Place Unlit
Campfires are placed unlit instead of already burning.
Campfires Set Entities On Fire
Campfires will set fire to entities standing on them.
Disable Axe Stripping
Disables in-world stripping of logs and wood using an axe.
Disable Copper Scraping
Disables in-world scraping of wax and oxidation from copper using an axe.
No Dinnerlava
Disables the generation of hidden single-block lava pockets in the Nether.
Ender Pearl Sound
Plays the Enderman teleport sound when an Ender Pearl hits the ground.
Spawn Egg Cracking
Spawn eggs produce cracking particles and play a sound effect when used.
Disable Anvil Damage
Prevents anvils from degrading, taking damage, or breaking from use and falling.
Tridents In Void Return
Loyalty tridents return when falling into the void instead of being destroyed.
Cactus Punching Hurts
Breaking or punching a cactus with bare hands damages the player.
Chaining Creepers
Creepers explode after taking explosion damage.
Furnace Minecart Accepts Any Fuel
Allows furnace minecarts to accept any furnace fuel, rather than just coal and charcoal.
Infinity Bows Require No Arrows
Bows enchanted with Infinity do not require having an arrow in your inventory to fire.
Tridents Accept Sharpness
Allows tridents to accept the Sharpness enchantment on an anvil, increasing melee and thrown damage (incompatible with Impaling).
Bedrock-Like Impaling
Makes the Impaling enchantment deal extra damage to any entity in water or rain.
Nether Cauldron
Water evaporates into steam when placed inside a cauldron in the Nether.
Fire Aspect Is Flint And Steel
Allows weapons with Fire Aspect to ignite blocks, campfires, TNT, and entities like flint and steel.
Cannot Open Chest When Targeted
Prevents opening chests, barrels, and shulker boxes while being targeted by hostile monsters.
Disable Path Creation
Disables in-world creation of dirt paths using a shovel.
Disable Farmland Creation
Disables in-world tilling of dirt and grass into farmland using a hoe.
Disable Ender Pearl Damage
Removes fall damage taken when teleporting with an Ender Pearl.
Dispenser Shears Pumpkins
Dispensers equipped with shears can carve pumpkins into carved pumpkins and drop pumpkin seeds.
Water Bottles On Concrete Powder
Using or dispensing water bottles on Concrete Powder turns it into the corresponding Concrete block, similar to making Mud from Dirt.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_walls.wa: Allows walls to visually connect to fences and wall signs.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_walls.fe: Allows fences to visually connect to walls, iron bars/panes, other fence types, and wall signs.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_walls.ba: Allows iron bars and glass panes to visually connect to fences, fence gates, and wall signs.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_gui.ctrl: Allows holding Control and clicking or dragging over items in your inventory to move them directly to the crafting grid.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_gui.chat: How long (in ticks) chat messages remain visible on screen before fading out. Vanilla default is 200.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_gui.disa: Stops the game from showing the Creative menu.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_gui.crea: Adds a delete item button to the survival inventory when in creative mode (Requires Disable Creative Inventory to be enabled).
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_gui.clea: Horizontal position of the inventory clear button relative to the inventory window.
Vertical position of the inventory clear button relative to the inventory window.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_gui.chat: Adds bold (**text**), italic (*text*), strikethrough (~~text~~), and underline (~text~) formatting to chat messages.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_gui.curs: Changes the mouse cursor shape when hovering buttons, sliders, text fields, scroll bars, disabled widgets, and clickable text links.
config.modulation.tweak.vanilla_gui.slot: Draws the slot hover highlight underneath the item instead of on top of it, keeping the item readable.
config.modulation.tweak.figura.enable_ta: Modifies the /figura load command with target selection and autocomplete (@a, @s, ...)
Farmer's Delight stoves are placed unlit instead of already burning.
config.modulation.tweak.reconnectible_ch: Enables the Chain Staff logic and post placement.
The time (in ticks) required to hold right-click before the staff casts a post (20 ticks = 1 second).
Whether the Chain Staff takes durability damage when placing chains.
Whether the Chain Staff requires and consumes Chains from your inventory.
message.modulation.no_chains: You don't have any Chains in your inventory!
message.modulation.no_chest_when_targete: You cannot open this while being targeted!
tooltip.modulation.switch_zipline_mode: Shift + Right-Click to switch to Zipline mode
config.modulation.tweak.passable_foliage: Leaves stay solid like scaffolding; hold shift to pass through them.
Spawns flung leaf particles when moving through Pale Oak leaves. Requires Vanilla Backport mod.
Spawns flung leaf particles when moving through Tinted leaves (Oak, Birch, Jungle, etc.). Requires Vanilla Backport mod.
Spawns flung needle particles when moving through Spruce leaves. Requires Vanilla Backport mod.
Spawns flung leaf particles when moving through Cherry leaves.
Base movement drag applied to entities inside leaves.
Maximum movement drag applied to entities inside leaves.
Plays rustling and breaking sound effects when moving through leaves.
Renders the cloud layer far past its vanilla radius. Ported from Extended Clouds.
How far clouds render relative to your render distance. Higher values cost more VRAM and build time.
Pushes the camera far plane out by the same multiplier so distant clouds are not clipped. Disable if you see depth artifacts.
Builds the cloud mesh on a background thread to avoid frame hitches. Clouds may lag one cell behind while rebuilding.
config.modulation.tweak.block_grid.enabl: Master toggle for sub-block grid snapping and block surface offsets.
Allows blocks like lanterns, torches, flower pots, redstone wire, and repeaters to snap to 1/16th grid offsets on slab/stair surfaces.
Allows signs to snap to 1/16th sub-block grid offsets on surface clicks.
Allows item frames and paintings to snap to sub-block surface edge offsets.
Offsets block particles to match the rendered offset of the block.
Translates block entity rendering (e.g., signs, chests) to match their block offset.
Allows offset redstone components to conduct signals through offset blocks.
Allows blocks to be placed on partial support surfaces (like slabs).
